decision.reason: [ev-7e3267b542c5] and [ev-a3db376e8800] state the subject and change concretely. Telemetry API CEL expressions must switch from filter_state["wasm.downstream_peer"/"wasm.upstream_peer"] to filter_state.downstream_peer/upstream_peer, from node to xds.node, and from unqualified Wasm attributes to fully qualified ones. Neither source says what happens to an expression left unchanged on a 1.24 proxy: whether it fails to evaluate, logs an error, or yields empty or default metric/log values. The open consequence aspect needs a source that states this runtime behaviour; inferring it from "now stored in" would be a guess.
